verdict.rationale: Klaviyo publishes an llms.txt at www.klaviyo.com/llms.txt. It describes headless access via the public APIs and MCP server, and the developer docs include an agent-oriented MCP server guide for Claude and Cursor. The probe's 404 is for the developers.klaviyo.com subdomain, not the main-site llms.txt, so it does not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: an llms.txt (or llms-full.txt) on the developer docs domain covering the API reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.
